headline.text: L3 demolding belt went down for *90 minutes* overnight but cleared with L1 maintenance assist; L1 flagged a bird's nest in the new sol 1 chiller that remains open.

per_plant_summary.L1: Ran caramel production across Sollich 2 with no line breaks. Two maintenance flags: a bird's nest discovered in the new sol 1 chiller at 01:47 and a completely plugged drain pipe next to the conbar at 03:39, both awaiting resolution. Second shift reinstalled a suction bar bracket on MM8 that was found loose at handoff.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 ran Imperial all day with one unplanned stop — the demolding belt moved north and required L1 maintenance from 00:16 to 01:47. Crew worked through display box version confusion on second shift but kept running. ML1 drain reported clogged at 06:13 and escalated to facilities. ML4 ran routine ATP checks with no issues.

notes.text: Heavy wash performed on Dishwasher 2, visual inspection passed at 11:38.
Floor cleaning results for tested area came back negative; containment curtain cleared to come down at 16:21.
Tyson moved purple drain brush to cabinet by truffle line, will label and stock Monday.
MFM discovered an IMS issue during box removal; 30718-bulk200 run will continue Monday.

resolved.title: MM8 suction bar bracket found loose at shift handoff
resolved.summary: Bracket from bottom suction bar on MM8 was discovered outside the machine during handoff; no product contamination risk as it was set aside.
resolved.resolution: Part reinstalled at 15:19 — "The part is complete; nothing is missing. We are going to install it" (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: ML1 demolding belt un-aligned and drifting north
resolved.summary: Imperial demolding belt moved toward north side, line went down at 00:16 requiring L1 maintenance escalation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:47 — "Line is back up, we're cleaning side belt while emptying out cooler" (Kimberly Morales). L1 maintenance assisted.

resolved.title: Display box version mismatch on ML1
resolved.summary: Warehouse delivered two different display case versions (both marked V4, same item number) causing scanning and tracking confusion on second shift.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 21:32 — Preston approved continued use: "I don't see any problem using them, if possible, we should keep them separated the best we can though."

needs_attention.title: Bird's nest found in new chiller of sol 1
needs_attention.summary: What appears to be a bird's nest was discovered inside the new chiller on Sollich 1 during overnight shift.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 01:47 with photo; no follow-up action or clearance documented as of window close.

needs_attention.title: Drain pipe next to conbar completely plugged
needs_attention.summary: Drain line adjacent to conbar is blocked solid and not draining; facilities contacted for assistance.
needs_attention.status: Jordan from facilities assessed at 03:39; pipe is "rock solid inside" with no resolution yet.

needs_attention.title: ML1 drain clogged and requires unclogging
needs_attention.summary: Molding Line 1 drain is clogged and needs immediate attention to restore proper sanitation functionality.
needs_attention.status: Preston escalated to William Lopez (facilities) at 06:47 asking for team assistance; no resolution posted as of 07:15.
